format: Branded podcast of a Miami multi-family office (fee-only RIA, ~$1.6B AUM per Kitces). Two hosts. Billed as twice a month on Thursdays. ~50 min episodes, also on YouTube (@On-Pointe-Podcast) as video. Guests are specialists in wealth, investing, philanthropy, cybersecurity, art, travel and private aviation, some of them Element Pointe staff. Studio is likely Miami (unverified).
